content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler crunchies are soft, crunchy snacks specially designed for children aged 12 months to 3 years. They are made from whole grains, fruits and vegetables, without artificial colours, flavours or preservatives. The snack is easy to chew and helps develop independent eating skills.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The snacks are shaped into small “finger‑size” pieces that are easy for little hands to hold.
The formula includes whole grains such as oats and rice, plus dried fruit and vegetable purees.
One serving provides about 30 % of the daily vitamin C requirement for 1‑ to 3‑year‑olds.
Each batch is tested to ensure no small particles that could increase choking risk.
Packaging is made from recyclable material and can be opened with one hand.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 support energy metabolism and nervous system development in toddlers.

items.title: Contains dietary fibre
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps establish a beneficial gut microbiome.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Iron is essential for hemoglobin formation and helps prevent anemia.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Minimal added sugar helps foster healthy taste preferences early on.

items.title: Supports bone growth
items.content: The snack provides calcium and vitamin D, which contribute to strong bone development.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: Children with known allergies to wheat, oats or rice should avoid this product.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Despite the shape, small pieces may still pose a choking risk for children under 12 months.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The product contains a modest amount of salt; consider this if the child's diet is low‑sodium.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Offer 2–3 pieces as a snack between meals. The crunchies can be served with milk, yogurt or fruit puree. Keep them dry so they stay crisp.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the original package in a cool, dry place. After opening, reseal tightly or transfer to an airtight container. Shelf life is 12 months.
